Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Recipe Name: Slow Cooker Creamy Garlic Parmesan Pork Chops Ingredients 1. 4 bone-in pork chops 2. 1 tsp salt 3. 1/2 tsp black pepper 4. 1 tsp garlic powder 5. 1 tsp onion powder 6. 1 tbsp olive oil 7. 3 tbsp butter 8. 4 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 cup chicken broth 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 13. 1/2 tsp paprika 14. 1 tbsp cornstarch 15. 2 tbsp water 16. 2 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Sear the pork chops for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown. 5. Transfer the pork chops to a slow cooker. 6. In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté the garlic for 30 seconds. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up any browned bits from the pan. 8. Stir in the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, and Italian seasoning. 9. Pour the creamy mixture over the pork chops in the slow cooker. 10. Cover and cook on LOW for 5–6 hours or HIGH for 2½–3 hours. 11. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl until smooth. 12. Stir the slurry into the slow cooker during the last 20 minutes of cooking. 13. Let the sauce thicken while the pork chops finish cooking. 14. Spoon the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce over the pork chops. 15. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving. 16. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, rice, or roasted vegetables. Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Crockpot Mongolian Beef & Noodles 🥩🍜🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 7: Mongolian Beef & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. Tender chuck roast, a sweet and savory Mongolian-style sauce, and noodles coated in all that flavor. We sear the beef for extra color, then the crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced chuck roast 4 tablespoons butter, for searing ½ cup low-sodium shoyu 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup low-sodium beef broth 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon grated ginger 2 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons cold water 12 ounces precooked lo mein noodles Sliced green onions Sesame seeds, optional Instructions: 1. Season your beef with SPG or your favorite seasoning. Heat a skillet over high heat with the butter and sear the beef in small batches for 1-2 minutes per side. You’re building color, not cooking it through. 2. Transfer the beef to the crockpot. Deglaze the skillet with a splash of the measured beef broth, scrape up those browned bits, and pour everything into the crockpot. 3. Add the remaining broth, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper. Stir gently. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2.5 to 3.5 hours. Start checking early so the thin beef stays tender without falling apart. 5. Mix the cornstarch slurry with a cup of broth. Stir the slurry into the sauce and cook on HIGH for 15–20 minutes, until thick and glossy. 6. Slice the green onions into 1 inch piece. Separate the precooked noodles and add them directly to the crockpot. Toss everything together and heat on HIGH for 5–10 minutes. 7. Finish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds, and chili crisp oil if you want some heat then serve immediately. Don’t leave those noodles sitting on KEEP WARM—they’ll keep drinking up the sauce. Сделайте основу тестаВ глубокой миске смешайте яйца, сахар и соль. Взбейте массу венчиком или миксером до появления легкой пены.2. Введите часть молокаВлейте к яйцам примерно 150-200 мл теплого молока и перемешайте. Если добавить все молоко сразу, в тесте при добавлении муки образуются комочки.3. Добавьте мукуПросейте всю муку в миску. Тщательно вымешайте венчиком до получения густого, абсолютно однородного теста.4. Разведите тестоПостепенно влейте оставшееся молоко, постоянно помешивая массу венчиком. В самом конце добавьте растительное масло. Оставьте тесто «отдохнуть» на 10-15 минут при комнатной температуре.5. Пожарьте блинчикиХорошо разогрейте сковороду. Смажьте её каплей масла только перед первым блином. Наливайте тесто половником, быстро распределяя его по дну круговыми движениями сковороды. Жарьте на среднем огне по 1-2 минуты с одной стороны (до золотистых краев) и около 30 секунд со второй.Секреты идеальных блиновТемпература: Молоко и яйца должны быть комнатной температуры или слегка теплыми, чтобы клейковина муки лучше разошлась.Масло в тесте: Растительное масло внутри смеси не даст блинчикам пригорать, и вам не придется смазывать сковороду каждый раз.Нежность: Чтобы блины оставались мягкими, складывайте их стопкой на тарелку и смазывайте каждый кусочком сливочного масла.Скажите, вы планируете делать блинчики с начинкой или кушать просто так? Creamy Shrimp Alfredo Penne with Broccoli Tender shrimp, fresh broccoli, and penne pasta come together in a creamy garlic-Parmesan sauce for a comforting dinner that’s simple enough for any night of the week. Ingredients 12 oz penne pasta 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined 3 cups broccoli florets 1 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp butter 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp salt ¼ tsp black pepper 1 cup heavy cream ¾ cup chicken broth 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan ½ cup shredded mozzarella 2 tbsp chopped parsley Instructions Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne until al dente, about 10–12 minutes. During the last 3 minutes of cooking, add the broccoli. Save ½ cup of the pasta water, then drain the pasta and broccoli. Pat the shrimp dry and season with Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and cook for 1–2 minutes on each side until pink and lightly browned. Remove from the skillet and set aside. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Stir in the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream. Let the sauce gently simmer for 3–4 minutes. Add the Parmesan and mozzarella, stirring until the cheese melts and the sauce becomes creamy and smooth. Add the cooked penne and broccoli to the skillet and toss until everything is evenly coated. If the sauce is too thick, stir in a little of the reserved pasta water. Return the shrimp to the skillet and cook for another 1–2 minutes, just until heated through. Finish with chopped parsley and serve warm with garlic bread or a fresh green salad. Storage Keep leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Reheat gently, adding a splash of milk or chicken broth to loosen the sauce. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 20 minutes Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 680 per serving #pasta #shrimp #food #dinnertime

Recipe Name Slow Cooker Brown Sugar Glazed Pork Chops Ingredients 1. 6 thick-cut boneless pork chops 2. 1/3 cup brown sugar 3. 1/4 cup soy sauce 4. 1/4 cup chicken broth 5. 2 tbsp honey 6. 2 tbsp olive oil 7. 4 cloves garlic, minced 8. 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 1 tsp smoked paprika 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1/2 tsp onion powder 12. 1/2 tsp black pepper 13. 1/2 tsp salt 14. 1 tbsp cornstarch 15. 2 tbsp cold water 16. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Sear the pork chops for 2–3 minutes per side until nicely browned. 5. Transfer the seared pork chops to the slow cooker. 6. Whisk together brown sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth, honey, Worcestershire sauce, and minced garlic. 7. Pour the glaze mixture evenly over the pork chops. 8. Cover and cook on LOW for about 3–4 hours, or until the pork reaches 145°F (63°C). 9. Carefully remove the pork chops and place them on a plate. 10. Pour the cooking liquid into a saucepan and bring it to a gentle simmer. 11. Mix cornstarch with cold water until completely smooth. 12. Slowly whisk the cornstarch mixture into the simmering sauce. 13. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the sauce becomes thick, glossy, and sticky. 14. Return the pork chops to the sauce and spoon the glaze generously over each piece. 15. Let the pork rest for a few minutes so it stays juicy. 16.
